name: USC Summer Programs (pre-college)
org: University of Southern California, Summer Programs
what_you_do: Take one college-level course on USC's campus with college faculty. Choose from 20+ courses in many subjects and earn 3 units of elective credit on a USC transcript.
who_can_apply: High school students who have completed ninth grade by the start of the program and are pursuing a rigorous curriculum. Domestic and international students may apply.
pay_detail: Posted totals for domestic students: $8,371 commuter or $11,946 residential. That adds tuition $7,617, course materials $300, program fee $350 and health center $104; residential adds $3,575 room and board. Also a $85 nonrefundable application fee and a $1,000 nonrefundable deposit that counts toward the total.
duration: Four weeks, 9 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. each class day. For 2027 the admissions page says classes begin Monday, June 21; the FAQ says Tuesday, June 22 through Friday, July 16.
deadline_text: 2027 deadlines are May 7, 2027 at 12 p.m. PT for domestic and March 12, 2027 at 12 p.m. PT for international applicants. Decisions are rolling and classes fill quickly. No application start date is posted, so check with summer@usc.edu.
how_to_apply: Online application with the $85 fee. Email summer@usc.edu with questions.
notes: Expensive. The FAQ says financial aid or assistance is not offered for USC Summer Programs. The fee table has no year label; it sits with the 2027 dates and deadlines. The two pages differ on the first day of class, so confirm it.
